coordinator.role: cognitive phase coordinator; never a worker fleet head

noesis-full.note: Historical sessions may resolve this alias; new project contracts and generated adapters must never write it.

native_orchestrator.role: session pin: classify/plan/dispatch via live OmniRoute capacity — never announce inactive Sol/Claude/Grok seats
native_orchestrator.note: Hooks resolve native/head from provider-class + live combo stack. Codex is active again; Sol remains explicit opt-in and never becomes the native default.

model_migrations.note: Codex Spark is eligible after live recovery. Sol still requires provider-class.sol_policy.operator_authorized=true plus the quota/reset gate; never announce Sol as native.

babysit_by_complexity.comment: Complexity selects the combo. Each combo HEAD is the babysit model for that band. Failover is health, not effort.

bands.session: Sonnet / default Claude Code / temperance-auto ALGORITHM / temperance-algorithm
Cursor Opus-high / noesis-plan-max (Claude OmniRoute hard-off — use cursor/ + BCP)

execute_workers.head: codex/gpt-5.3-codex-spark
execute_workers.note: Current paid-fleet head after Codex recovery. Not a babysit rail; Parallel Execute only.

claude_code_gateway.comment: Claude Code only has five Anthropic-shaped alias slots. Those five ARE the complexity bands across sessions. Classifier cannot swap ANTHROPIC_MODEL mid-session.

complexity_slots.haiku_and_fast: lite -> noesis-fast -> current live head nous/stealth/ox-alpha, then combo failover
complexity_slots.sonnet_and_default: standard ALGORITHM -> noesis-build through the Anthropic-shaped Gateway; Claude OmniRoute remains hard-off

pin_explicitly.noesis-plan: simple ALGORITHM plan through the current noesis-plan stack without Max burn

ralph.anti: Do not hand-edit combo stacks per Ralph iteration

optimize.anti: One variable per experiment; no full-DB backups

next_wave.auto_rule: NEXT-WAVE is a proposal, never execution authority. Render and persist its options; dispatch only after a matching, unexpired human approval receipt confirms the option, plan fingerprint, policy hash, and bounded concurrency.

session_limits.source: codexbar CLI/GUI first; OmniRoute quota_snapshots only as labeled fallback

do_not: Hand-edit every te-* stack for one quota event
Put Sol/Fable as default heads on noesis-fast/noesis-build/noesis-observe/noesis-swarm
do: Read CodexBar GUI or `codexbar usage --provider codex --source auto` (Claude CLI often times out ~100-160s; use GUI)
Update classify-task.sh model_for_type if Command Code deals changed
Update lane-templates-from-live.json CC promo seats only
Paid leftover: python3 rank-paid-fleet.py --apply-combo (add --include-sol only after explicit operator authorization and when Codex weekly remaining >=20% with reset <24h)
Keep one combos-before.json per apply, never another full DB copy

rules: Before Execute fleet fan-out, prefer a fresh paid-fleet ranking if snapshot is >6h stale.
Seats with remaining_pct < 5 or is_exhausted are hard-ineligible for noesis-execute.
When Claude 5h session remaining < 25%, divert workers to Spark/Cursor/Antigravity-Gemini before Claude Max.
Never put Sol seats in noesis-execute without explicit --include-sol authorization.
Capacity phases (Observe/Think/Plan/Build/Verify/Learn side work) stay on noesis-observe/noesis-plan/noesis-build/noesis-fast — do not burn Max session on babysit.
Kimi monthly-exhausted seats stay out of paid fleet even if 5h/weekly rate windows look free.
SuperGrok (grok-cli/*) is a paid seat; include via rank-paid-fleet when rem>=20%.
Canonical docs: primary ~/.temperance_engine/docs/ROUTING.md plus the eight-file routing corpus in canonical_docs.routing_corpus.
plan-max → noesis-plan-max (Fable/Sol/Opus); only when complexity signals fire.
Screenshots/settings audits → prefer plan-max + Vision Bridge (gemini/gemini-2.5-flash).
noesis-plan-max must emit TASK GRAPH + SWARM handoff; never one-round micro-fix as done.
noesis-swarm is capacity fan-out only; never Sol/Fable heads on swarm.
notes: Execute fleet is noesis-execute only (ranked paid seats + SuperGrok).
Capacity phases stay on noesis-observe/noesis-plan/noesis-build/noesis-fast — do not burn Sol/Fable as silent defaults.
Sol/Fable/Opus are explicit pins when user wants max creative/planning spend.
Legacy Sol-first docs archived under docs/archive/*-pre-routing-cleanup/

forbidden_on_orchestrator: Do not implement multi-file changes in the native session when a combo is recommended.
Do not use legacy noesis-execute; use noesis-execute.
Do not pin Sol as worker fleet head without explicit authorization.
Do not pin exhausted Antigravity Claude seats when quota_snapshots show remaining 0.
Do not burn Claude Max 5h session on capacity-class side-quests (use noesis-fast).

missing_or_broken: perplexity-search (needs Search API key, not perplexity-web session)

schema_extensions.canonical_docs: Backward-compatible v2 field extension. Consumers must accept either the legacy string path or an object with primary and routing_corpus; no runtime consumer dereferenced this field when extended on 2026-08-24.

modes.temperance-algorithm: pin noesis-orchestrator; Plan slices may hard-route noesis-plan-max when task_type=plan-max
modes.temperance-planner: complexity-aware: noesis-plan or noesis-plan-max from classify-task.sh

algorithm_phases_notes: Default Plan phase uses noesis-plan. When classifier returns plan-max (complex ALGORITHM planning), use noesis-plan-max instead.

commands.swarm_batch: temperance-batch with model noesis-swarm for capacity slices
commands.paid_batch: temperance-batch with noesis-execute for paid implement

skill_discovery: For each capability gap, run temperance-discover-skills.sh
Prefer local skill-clusters hubs/spokes before marketplace
SkillsMP via OmniRoute when local miss (skillsProvider=skillsmp)
Install public skills only with user approval; then re-tier + gen-index

skills.plan_max_rule: On noesis-plan/noesis-plan-max deep pass, emit SKILL GAPS in TASK GRAPH with resolve path local|skillsmp|install

superset_grok.comment: Grok CLI default babysit is native grok-4.6 (SuperGrok). Lite/max pin OmniRoute custom models via wrapper inject. Terminal launcher ~/.local/bin/grok and Superset ~/.superset/bin/grok both source superset-grok-inject.sh.

superset_opencode.comment: OpenCode default_agent is temperance-auto (per-turn OmniRoute). Superset wrapper must NOT set OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR to ~/.superset/hooks/opencode (plugin-only). Notify plugin lives in ~/.config/opencode/plugins.

superset_claude.comment: Superset Claude execute seat. Default coordinator pin noesis-orchestrator. Wrapper sources superset-claude-inject.sh.

temperance-engine.note: Primary coordination lane. noesis-full is compatibility-only; phase workers use their canonical noesis-* lanes.
